newsitem.title: USA: BP to shut Lima, Ohio refinery - Union.
newsitem.headline: BP to shut Lima, Ohio refinery - Union.

text.p: BP America Inc, U.S. unit of British Petroleum, sent a letter to union workers at the Lima, Ohio refinery Thursday informing employees it planned to shut the refinery as bids for the sale of the unit were unacceptable, union sources said.
A BP spokeswoman confirmed that the company plans a phased shut down of the refinery over a two year period.
The refinery has a rated capacity of 161,000 barrel per day (bpd) and supplies the U.S. Midwest market with products.
"The sales process yielded few bids, and all were unacceptable," the BP spokeswoman told Reuters.
She said BP intended to suspend crude oil operations in approximately two years.
The company's major thrust was now to pursue other options to meet its refined petroleum products commitments.
She assured the process would be a gradual phasing out rather than an immediate shutdown.
